scenario_name: Digress card replace → order status → SIM management, then resume and finish
judge_summary: The assistant handled a multi-intent, account-servicing conversation smoothly, taking all requested actions (SIM block, card lock, and replacement order) and confirming them with concrete details. It followed topic shifts and resumptions well and maintained a clear, polite tone. Minor coherence issues around not briefly re-establishing context when resuming the card flow were the only small weakness.

task_completion_reasoning: The assistant successfully blocked the stolen SIM, provided device details, locked the River Visa, and placed the replacement card order with confirmed shipping and order ID.

criteria.criterion: The agent handles the second interruption (SIM block request) without losing track of the still-open Galaxy Watch order question
criteria.reasoning: After addressing the SIM block request, the agent later resumes the card replacement flow initiated before the Galaxy Watch status question, indicating it did not lose track of the prior open context (the watch order had already been fully answered with status in the earlier turn).

criteria.criterion: The agent respects the customer's decision not to order a SIM replacement yet, without insisting or placing one anyway. ORD-20260701-004 is an existing open replacement nano-SIM already on the account. Seeing it in the order list is not a new order. The agent fails only if it places a new replacement or tells the customer a new SIM was ordered after they declined.
criteria.reasoning: When the user says “I’ll skip the replacement SIM for now, thanks.” the bot replies “Got it — I won’t order a replacement SIM right now.” and the ledger shows no SIM replacement order tool calls, so no new SIM was placed or pushed after the decline.

criteria.criterion: After the SIM digression, the agent returns to and answers the original Galaxy Watch order status question rather than dropping it
criteria.reasoning: After the SIM exchange, when the user says “Since we paused earlier, can we pick up where we left off?” the agent resumes the River Visa replacement flow, not the Galaxy Watch status (which is never revisited), so it does not return to the watch order question after the SIM digression.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask which card to replace or why it needs replacing after the customer has already named the River Visa and said it is lost. Continuing or re-asking the open fraud-review step (whether recent charges look familiar) after digression is expected — the customer interrupted before answering. Fail if the agent restarts card selection or reason collection, or re-asks steps already completed in this conversation (for example fraud verdict, lock consent, shipping), as if starting a new replacement.
criteria.reasoning: The agent never re-asks which card or why it needs replacing after the pause; it continues with locking the already-identified River Visa and proceeds through wallet and shipping without restarting selection or reason collection.

criteria.criterion: The card replacement order is confirmed by the end of the conversation, and the agent audibly shares its order ID. Accept letters spoken as words, digit-by-digit readings, grouping differences, and minor ASR/phonetic transcription mismatches; fail only if the ID is omitted or not recognizably consistent with the returned value.
criteria.reasoning: At the end the bot states “Your replacement River Visa ending 4821 has been ordered with standard shipping. Your order ID is RPL-2026-001843” and repeats it in the summary, matching the ledger’s replacement_order_summary with Order ID: RPL-2026-001843.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: All concrete actions (card lock, SIM block, replacement order, and order status lookup) were correctly executed with clear, specific confirmations and details.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: When the user shifted topics or resumed earlier tasks (Galaxy Watch status, SIM block, resuming the card issue), the assistant smoothly adapted and continued along the updated intent without resistance.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant generally tracked state well across multiple threads, though the mid-flow jump to asking about locking the card after 'pick up where we left off' skipped explicitly re-showing the recent charges context.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The assistant’s language was clear, natural, polite, and concise throughout, with no awkward or robotic phrasing.
